name: radiators-csxcad-editor
description: Parametric CSXCAD geometry editor for radiators schema v2 configs (static web app, Capacitor-ready).

scripts.android:init: python3 prepare.py && npm i -D @capacitor/cli@6 && npm i @capacitor/core@6 @capacitor/android@6 @capacitor/filesystem@6 @capacitor/share@6 && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: python3 prepare.py && npx cap sync android
